Planning a dream trip to Mauritius from India?
Mauritius is full of wonders, but nothing prepares you for the famous Underwater Waterfall of Mauritius — especially when you see it from a seaplane
In this full-length video, we take you on an unforgettable seaplane experience over Mauritius, where you can witness the breathtaking illusion of the underwater waterfall near Le Morne. From crystal-clear lagoons to dramatic ocean depths, this view feels unreal.
Is the underwater waterfall real? Why does it look like water flowing into the ocean? And is the seaplane experience worth it?
